objective: Synthetic browser translation benchmark fixture: preserve the A-B-B-A task route across handoff.

Do not fast-forward, merge, rebase, or otherwise change a Git branch.

STOP BLOCKED if the existing Chrome bridge is unavailable; do not substitute browser smoke testing.

acceptance.criterion: Four recorded benchmark legs exist in exact A-B-B-A order.
Gemini Nano acceptance evidence is present at the declared artifact location.
